abstract: We present a valuation framework for measuring the non-market net operating surplus associated with threatened wild species preservation for monetary ecosystem accounting . We use the Simulated Exchange Value ( SEV ) method, which estimates the maximum benefit that could be internalized in a hypothetical market using the demand simulated from a choice experiment, a given market supply, and an assumed market structure. The choice experiment estimates willingness to pay (WTP), in addition to current tax-funded costs, for achieving different stock levels of wild species across threat categories defined by the International Union for Conservation of Nature Red List. We apply this framework to the valuation of threatened waterbird species preservation in the coastal wetlands of the southwestern Iberian Peninsula. The results show that WTP increases as the number of threatened species decreases, with the critically endangered species generating the highest WTP and no statistically significant differences between vulnerable and endangered species. Based on our preferred model, we estimate a SEV of the net operating surplus of €2,850 per hectare per year for the current stock levels of threatened waterbird species. The equivalent variation estimated for the same stock level is €4,108 per hectare per year.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种估值框架，用于衡量与受威胁野生物种保护相关的非市场净经营盈余，以服务于货币化生态系统核算。我们采用模拟交换价值（SEV）方法，该方法通过选择实验模拟的需求、给定的市场供给以及假定的市场结构，估算在假设市场中可内部化的最大收益。该选择实验估算了除当前税收资助成本之外，为实现国际自然保护联盟（IUCN）红色名录所定义的不同威胁类别野生物种存量水平而支付的意愿（WTP）。我们将此框架应用于伊比利亚半岛西南部沿海湿地受威胁水鸟物种保护的估值。结果显示，随着受威胁物种数量的减少，WTP增加，其中极危物种产生的WTP最高，而易危物种与濒危物种之间无统计学显著差异。基于我们的优选模型，我们估算出当前受威胁水鸟物种存量水平的净经营盈余SEV为每公顷每年2850欧元。同一存量水平下估算的等价变差为每公顷每年4108欧元。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Integrating Threatened Biodiversity in Monetary Ecosystem Accounting: Choice Experiments and Simulated Exchange Values
title_zh: 将受威胁生物多样性纳入货币化生态系统核算：选择实验与模拟交换价值

abstract: We present the first large-scale field experiment evaluating the integration of generative AI into a national justice system. In partnership with Pakistan's judiciary, we built JudgeGPT, a custom generative AI assistant designed for Pakistan's trial courts, and randomized 1,559 judges serving across 118 courts into one of three arms: (i) access to the assistant with targeted training tailored to its use; (ii) access to AI with generic training on technology and law; and (iii) generic training without access to AI. Judges who received AI access together with targeted training on the use of the tool were more likely to adopt it, use it more intensively, and continue using it over time. Their attitudes toward AI also shift: they expect the tool and the targeted training to increase their productivity. Administrative records move in the same direction: districts with greater exposure to treated judges resolve more cases. At median-district exposure, introducing AI with targeted training corresponds to 1,848 additional cases resolved per year, a 6.3 percent increase over the mean. This increase does not appear to come at the expense of reduced quality, as measured by case appeals (which slightly decline) or text-based measures of judicial writing (which slightly improve). Chat-log-based usage patterns suggest that judges use AI mainly to clarify legal concepts and support drafting. Targeted training appears to shift use toward tasks where language models are likely to be more useful, such as text improvement, and away from more open-ended legal queries where responses are more costly to verify. Overall, the results suggest that generative AI can raise public-sector productivity, but that these gains may depend on targeted training that directs use toward tasks for which the tool is better suited.
abstract_zh: 我们开展了首个大规模实地实验，评估将生成式人工智能整合进国家司法系统的效果。通过与巴基斯坦司法机构合作，我们构建了专为巴基斯坦初审法院设计的定制化生成式AI助手JudgeGPT，并将分布在118个法院的1559名法官随机分为三组：（i）获得AI助手并接受针对其使用的定向培训；（ii）获得AI助手并接受技术与法律通用培训；（iii）仅接受通用培训但无AI访问权限。结果显示，获得AI访问权限并接受定向培训的法官更倾向于采用该工具，使用频率更高且持续性更强。他们对AI的态度也发生转变：预期该工具及定向培训能提升自身工作效率。行政记录数据印证了这一趋势：接触过受训法官的地区案件处理量显著增加。在地区中位暴露水平下，引入AI并配合定向培训相当于每年多处理1848起案件，较均值提升6.3%。这种增长并未以质量下降为代价——案件上诉率（略有下降）和基于文本的司法文书质量指标（略有改善）均未出现负面变化。基于聊天日志的使用模式显示，法官主要利用AI澄清法律概念和辅助文书起草。定向培训促使使用行为从开放式法律咨询（此类回复验证成本较高）转向语言模型更擅长的任务（如文本优化）。总体而言，研究结果表明生成式AI能提升公共部门生产力，但这种提升可能取决于能否通过定向培训引导用户将工具应用于更适配的任务场景。
title: Courts of Tomorrow: Evidence from a Nationwide Rollout of Generative AI
title_zh: DP21783 明日法庭：生成式人工智能全国推广的证据

abstract: We study the long-run effects of a large public expansion of pre-primary education in Argentina. Between 1993 and 1999, the federal government financed the construction of new preschool classrooms targeted to departments with low baseline enrollment and high poverty, creating roughly 186,000 additional places. We link administrative records on classroom construction to four population censuses and estimate difference-in-differences models that compare treated and untreated cohorts across high- and low-construction departments. An additional preschool seat per child increases post-kindergarten schooling by about 0.5 years, raising the probability of completing secondary school by 11.9 percentage points and of attaining any post-secondary education by 7.1 percentage points. For women, access to the program also reduces fertility: an additional seat lowers the number of live births per woman by 0.20. Across several checks using cohort sizes, household composition, province-of-birth restrictions, and direct migration measures, we find little evidence consistent with systematic selective migration, suggesting that migration is unlikely to be a major source of bias in our estimates. Our results show little impact on labor-market outcomes at the census date, consistent with beneficiaries still being in school or in the early stages of their careers. A benefit-cost analysis based on the estimated schooling gains, standard Mincer returns, and observed construction and operating costs yields a benefit-cost ratio of about 11 and an internal rate of return of 13\%. Our findings show that universal at-scale pre-primary expansions in middle-income countries can generate sizable improvements in human capital and demographic outcomes at relatively low fiscal cost.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了阿根廷大规模公立学前教育扩张的长期效应。1993年至1999年间，联邦政府资助新建了针对基线入学率低且贫困程度高的地区的学前教育教室，新增约18.6万个学位。我们将教室建设的行政记录与四次人口普查数据相关联，采用双重差分模型比较高建设密度与低建设密度地区中受政策影响与未受影响的群体。每增加一个儿童学前教育学位，可使幼儿园后的受教育年限提高约0.5年，高中毕业概率提升11.9个百分点，接受高等教育的概率提升7.1个百分点。对女性而言，该政策还降低了生育率：每增加一个学位可使每位女性的活产数减少0.20。通过使用队列规模、家庭构成、出生省份限制及直接迁移指标等多项检验，我们未发现系统性选择性迁移的显著证据，表明迁移不太可能成为估计偏差的主要来源。结果显示，该政策在普查时点对劳动力市场影响甚微，这与受益者仍处于在校或职业生涯早期阶段的情况相符。基于估算的教育收益、标准明瑟回报率以及实际建设与运营成本进行的成本收益分析表明，收益成本比约为11，内部收益率为13%。本研究表明，中等收入国家大规模普及学前教育能以相对较低的财政成本显著提升人力资本与人口结构指标。
title: Long-run Effects of Universal Pre-Primary Education Expansion: Evidence from Argentina
title_zh: DP21782 普及学前教育扩张的长期效应：来自阿根廷的证据

abstract: Using employer-employee Italian data over the period 1998-2018 we analyze the impact of the largest regularization of undocumented immigrant workers in Italy on wage, employment and mobility outcomes of natives. Our empirical strategy takes advantage of the 2002 Bossi-Fini law that unexpectedly regularized 634,000 undocumented non-EU immigrants, with variation across firms and provinces that was not correlated with previous economic performance. We find that the policy had a small effect on the average wage of native workers and positive effects on their employment at the local labor market level. Additionally, native co-workers in firms more affected by the policy were more likely to change employers in the post-policy period. Such higher mobility resulted in a heterogeneous wage effect across switchers: workers that managed to transition towards better firms experienced wage gains in the medium- and long-run, while other workers experienced wage losses. This implied an increase in wage dispersion for natives and some losers among Italian workers.
abstract_zh: 基于1998-2018年意大利雇主-雇员匹配数据，本文分析了意大利最大规模非法移民合法化政策对本土劳动者工资、就业及流动性的影响。实证策略利用2002年《博西-菲尼法》意外合法化63.4万非欧盟非法移民这一准自然实验，通过企业与省份层面的变异识别政策效应，且该变异与地区前期经济表现无关。研究发现：该政策对本土劳动者平均工资影响较小，但在地方劳动力市场层面产生了正向就业效应；此外，受政策冲击较大的企业中，本土同事在政策实施后更可能更换雇主。这种高流动性导致流动者面临异质性工资效应：成功转向优质企业的劳动者在中长期获得工资增长，而其他流动者则遭受工资损失。这最终加剧了本土劳动者的工资离散度，并导致部分意大利劳动者成为政策受损方。
title: Immigrants' Regularization and Native Workers' Response
title_zh: DP21781 移民身份合法化与本土工人的反应

abstract: Quantifying spillovers from scientific knowledge to technology is important for understanding the social returns to science and for designing policy. A key challenge is how to credit scientific work with the value generated in downstream technologies when ideas diffuse through chains of follow-on research. We propose a new measure---Science Rank---that uses the combined patent and paper citation network to assign a share of the private value of patented inventions to the scientific papers they directly or indirectly rely on. Validated against various types of scientific awards, the measure substantially outperforms direct patent-to-paper citation counts in identifying influential science. We document large heterogeneity in spillovers across countries, disciplines, and institutions. The US emerges from our analysis as a powerhouse of science spillovers, benefiting both domestic and foreign technology development. We apply our methodology to examine how different countries and individual institutions contribute to innovation that addresses global challenges such as climate change or more equal economic development. We find that a relatively large share of the total value generated by research in Lower and Middle Income Country (LMIC) feeds into climate change related innovation. We also highlight countries and institutions that are making particular contributions to LMIC innovation.
abstract_zh: 量化科学知识向技术的溢出效应，对于理解科学的社会回报以及制定相关政策至关重要。当思想通过后续研究的链条传播时，如何将下游技术产生的价值归功于科学工作，是一个关键挑战。我们提出了一种新指标——科学排名（Science Rank）——利用专利与论文的联合引用网络，将专利发明的私人价值份额分配给其直接或间接依赖的科学论文。经多种科学奖项验证，该指标在识别具有影响力的科学成果方面，显著优于直接的专利-论文引用计数。我们记录了不同国家、学科和机构之间溢出效应的巨大异质性。分析显示，美国是科学溢出的强国，其科学成果惠及国内外技术发展。我们应用该方法考察了不同国家和机构如何为应对气候变化或促进更公平经济发展等全球挑战的创新做出贡献。研究发现，中低收入国家（LMIC）研究产生的总价值中，有相对较大的一部分流向了与气候变化相关的创新。我们还重点指出了那些为LMIC创新做出特殊贡献的国家和机构。
title: Spillovers from Science

abstract: We study the effects of taxi market deregulation in Finland, which removed price controls and lowered barriers to entry. The reform led to a surge in firm entry and a modest increase in exit, indicating substantial changes in market structure. Average taxi prices increased slightly according to price indices, while monthly firm-level reported sales and VAT declined by over 10 percent. Operating costs and mileage remained largely unchanged, suggesting limited demand responses. These findings point to increased tax evasion following deregulation. Consistent with this interpretation, we document a small rise in property crime, with no effects on other criminal offenses.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了芬兰出租车市场放松管制的影响，该改革取消了价格控制并降低了市场准入门槛。改革导致企业大量进入市场，退出数量略有增加，表明市场结构发生了显著变化。根据价格指数，出租车平均价格小幅上涨，而企业月度报告销售额和增值税下降了超过10%。运营成本和行驶里程基本保持不变，表明需求反应有限。这些发现表明放松管制后逃税行为有所增加。与这一解释一致，我们记录了财产犯罪的小幅上升，而对其他刑事犯罪没有影响。
title: Taxi Market Deregulation: Effects on Market Outcomes, Tax Evasion and Crime
title_zh: DP21777 出租车市场放松管制：对市场结果、逃税和犯罪的影响

abstract: Japan's regional convergence of productivity levels throughout the twentieth century can be best described as a cumulative process of ‘catching up, forging ahead, and falling behind’. Using a novel dataset spanning 135 years (1874–2008), this study finds support for a crucial role played by structural transformation in convergence. The pace of productivity catch‐up and convergence accelerated in the mid‐1950s with the help of structural transformation, particularly in the period from 1955 to 1965. Structural transformation explains, on average, about 30 per cent of the aggregate productivity growth, and its effect intensified in prefectures with faster movements of labour across sectors and larger sectoral productivity gaps. However, since the early 1970s, its contribution to the convergence was frequently offset by within‐sector productivity growth, in turn thwarting the pace of convergence. These counter‐balancing effects contributed to the diverse pathways of productivity catch‐up at the prefecture level.
abstract_zh: 20世纪日本各区域生产率水平的收敛过程，可被最恰当地描述为“追赶、领先与落后”的累积性进程。本研究利用覆盖135年（1874-2008年）的新数据集，发现结构转型在收敛过程中发挥了关键作用。20世纪50年代中期，在结构转型的推动下，生产率追赶与收敛速度显著加快，尤其在1955年至1965年期间。结构转型平均解释了约30%的总体生产率增长，且其效应在劳动力跨部门流动更快、部门间生产率差距更大的县级行政区中更为显著。然而自20世纪70年代初以来，结构转型对收敛的贡献常被部门内生产率增长所抵消，进而阻碍了收敛进程。这些相互抵消的效应导致了县级层面生产率追赶路径的多元化。
title: The role of structural transformation in regional convergence in Japan: 1874–2008
title_zh: 日本区域趋同中的结构转型作用：1874–2008

abstract: We derive tight pricing kernel restrictions from options with same‐day expiration (“0DTEs”). These restrictions concern the volatility of small and frequent asset price moves that the equity and options markets must agree on in a frictionless economy. Their violation leads to pseudo‐arbitrage opportunities, characterized by nontrivial reward‐to‐risk ratios over arbitrarily short horizons and achieved by a combined position in 0DTEs and the underlying asset. Empirically, we find no evidence of feasible pseudo‐arbitrage opportunities, as transaction costs, estimation risk, and short‐term volatility risk prevent investors from taking advantage of small and infrequent disagreements about volatility between equity and options markets.
abstract_zh: 我们从同日到期的期权（“0DTEs”）中推导出严格的价格核约束。这些约束涉及股票和期权市场在无摩擦经济中必须达成一致的小幅频繁资产价格波动的波动性。违反这些约束会导致伪套利机会，其特征是在任意短的时间范围内具有非平凡的收益风险比，并通过在0DTEs和标的资产中建立组合头寸来实现。实证上，我们没有发现可行的伪套利机会的证据，因为交易成本、估计风险和短期波动风险阻止了投资者利用股票与期权市场之间关于波动性的微小且不频繁的分歧。
title: Do Equity and Options Markets Agree about Volatility?
title_zh: 股票与期权市场在波动率上是否一致？

title: Can policy design build trust in local taxation? Experimental evidence of property taxation in Mexican municipalities
title_zh: 政策设计能否建立对地方税收的信任？墨西哥市政财产税的实验证据

abstract: We investigate the impact of gender composition on team performance in a real-world setting using a large-scale survey conducted within Chinese firms. We study the performance of two-person interviewer teams, with gender composition randomly assigned, tasked with complex survey data collection. Our analysis shows that two-female teams outperform both mixed-gender and two-male teams in interview completion and refusal-based questionnaire quality. Specifically, assignment to an all-female team increases the likelihood of completing an interview by 2.4%, and reduces refusals to answer key questions by 5%. This performance difference is likely driven by improved task coordination and a more favorable communication environment in all-female teams. This leads to increased effort input and ultimately enhances team effectiveness.
abstract_zh: 我们利用在中国企业内部开展的大规模调查，在真实情境中探究性别构成对团队绩效的影响。研究对象为随机分配性别组合的两人访谈员团队，其任务为完成复杂的调查数据采集工作。分析表明，全女性团队在访谈完成率和基于拒答的问卷质量方面均优于混合性别团队及全男性团队。具体而言，被分配至全女性团队可使访谈完成概率提升2.4%，并将关键问题拒答率降低5%。这一绩效差异很可能源于全女性团队中任务协调的改善与更有利的沟通环境，进而促使团队成员投入更多努力，最终提升团队效能。

abstract: Children who start school at a younger age are more likely to receive pharmacological treatment for attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD). This pattern is widely attributed to peer-comparison biases, but the relative importance of different underlying mechanisms remains debated. We use administrative data from England to study how school starting age affects ADHD prescription rates from ages 5 to 15. Exploiting a sharp school-entry cutoff and comparing children born just before and after September 1, we estimate both age- and grade-specific effects of early school entry. We find that early starters are 40–50% more likely to be treated for ADHD by age 15. This long-term gap is entirely driven by first-time prescriptions among children aged 5 to 8. Using a novel decomposition strategy, we isolate the roles of relative age, absolute age, the length of school exposure, and age at school entry. We find that relative age is the primary long-term driver, aligning with previous evidence on peer-comparison bias, while absolute age and the length of school exposure have only short-lived effects. Our findings suggest that early starters are more likely to receive marginal diagnoses due to their relative immaturity, and we recommend refining diagnostic guidelines and classroom grouping practices to reduce diagnostic gaps.
abstract_zh: 入学年龄较小的儿童更可能因注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）接受药物治疗。这一现象被广泛归因于同伴比较偏差，但不同潜在机制的重要性仍存争议。我们利用英格兰行政数据，研究入学年龄如何影响5至15岁儿童的ADHD处方率。通过利用严格的入学年龄截止日期，并比较9月1日前后的出生儿童，我们估算了早期入学对年龄和年级的特定影响。研究发现，早期入学儿童在15岁时接受ADHD治疗的可能性高出40%-50%。这一长期差距完全由5至8岁儿童的首次处方驱动。采用新的分解策略，我们分离了相对年龄、绝对年龄、在校时长及入学年龄的作用。结果表明，相对年龄是主要的长期驱动因素，与先前关于同伴比较偏差的证据一致，而绝对年龄和在校时长仅产生短期效应。我们的发现表明，早期入学儿童因相对不成熟更易获得边缘性诊断，并建议完善诊断指南和课堂分组实践以减少诊断差距。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Why are the youngest in class more often prescribed pharmacological treatment for ADHD?
title_zh: 为何班级中最年幼的学生更常被开具ADHD药物治疗？

abstract: Europe is converging on a definition of economic security as reduced dependence – de-risking, reshoring, buying European. This column argues that the definition is mistaken. Three decades of evidence on financial and production networks shows that resilience is a property of a node’s position in the network – the depth, diversity, and quality of its connections – not of the number of connections it has severed for self-sufficiency. Applying this test to critical input supply chains such as energy and defence – with Turkey, the EU’s largest customs union partner, as the defining case – the author argues that Europe passes the initiative’s ‘Singapore test’ only if it treats integration depth, rather than self-sufficiency, as the union’s security variable.
abstract_zh: 欧洲正在就经济安全的定义达成共识，即减少依赖——去风险、回流、购买欧洲产品。本文认为这一定义存在谬误。三十年来关于金融与生产网络的证据表明，韧性取决于节点在网络中的位置属性——其连接的深度、多样性和质量——而非为追求自给自足而切断的连接数量。作者以欧盟最大关税同盟伙伴土耳其作为典型案例，将这一检验标准应用于能源和国防等关键投入供应链，论证指出：只有当欧盟将一体化深度而非自给自足视为联盟的安全变量时，欧洲才能通过该倡议的"新加坡测试"。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为欧洲经济安全与供应链，不涉及中国
title: Resilience is a network property: Europe’s integration test for 2050
title_zh: 韧性是一种网络属性：欧洲2050年一体化考验
